title: narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. abscissus
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. abscissus, commonly known as Wild Daffodil, is a plant species that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Wild Daffodil include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety as a medicinal agent.
